Content Marketing Assistant (Summer Student)

Company: Pinegrove Wellness Co.
Location: Burnaby, BC
Work Arrangement: Hybrid
Work Term: Summer 2027
Duration: 16 weeks
Salary: $23.00 per hour
Application Deadline: February 26, 2027

About the Role

Pinegrove Wellness Co. is a direct-to-consumer supplements brand. The Content Marketing
Assistant will support our editorial calendar and social media channels.

Responsibilities

- Draft blog and email content aligned to the content marketing calendar
- Schedule and publish social media posts
- Support SEO keyword research and reporting
